ADVERTISEMENT FOR WALK-IN INTERVIEW
Applications are invited from eligible candidates for engagement against the following project-based
positions of Technical Assistant and IPR Assistant at the Centre for Innovation, Incubation and
Entrepreneurship (CIIE), Institute of Technology, Zakura Campus, University of Kashmir. The selection
shall be made through a Walk-in Interview scheduled to be held on 30 November 2026 (Monday) at 2:00
p.m. at the Office of the Director, Institute of Technology, Zakura Campus, University of Kashmir.
Candidates are required to bring their original certificates and transcripts indicating their educational
qualifications and percentage of marks obtained in the qualifying examination, along with experience
certificates, if any, for verification at the time of the interview.

TERMS AND CONDITIONS OF ENGAGEMENT:
1. The selected candidates shall furnish an affidavit, duly sworn before a First-Class Magistrate or Notary
Public, declaring that they are not employed elsewhere and are not involved in any unlawful activity.
2. The engagement shall remain valid until the conclusion of the project or until the funds from the funding
agency cease to be available, whichever is earlier.
3. The engagement shall not confer any right or claim to permanent appointment in the University of
Kashmir.
4. Selected candidates shall be required to join within seven days from the date of issuance of the appointment
order, failing which their claim to the position shall stand forfeited.
5. No TA/DA shall be paid for attending the interview.
